items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: And so I took Jim in the band. ... And boy, me and Jim was talking all the time.

ctx.x: On his left leg it hit constantly.

Yeah. And when he walked through him, he had to be operated on the door, that stopped him. It stopped him from playing a long time. And so, so the sound said, well, I think it's up to you. You get a snare drum. I said, I pick up anybody. I make them play. So I started playing the bass drum until I got hot and hot and tired. I said, I ain't going to play anything anymore. And I said, I'm not going to play it. You better get somebody else. I said, well, I don't know who to get right now. I got to think. And I…
